latin: ORDO MISSÆ

notes: Only the printed psalm heading is carried. The preceding rubric line 'Postea alternatim cum Ministris dicit sequentem' (word-exact in both books) has no element in this frame and is not attached to the 1861 heading it does not translate.

latin: Et extendens, ac jungens manus, clara voce dicit: Orémus, et ascendens ad Altare, dicit secreto:
Deinde, manibus junctis super Altare, inclinatus dicit:
Deinde osculatur Altare in medio, et versus ad populum dicit:
Postea dicit: Orémus, et Orationes, unam aut plures, ut ordo Officii postulat. Sequitur Epistola, Graduale, Tractus, vel Allelúja cum Versu, aut Sequentia, prout Tempus aut qualitas Missæ postulat.
notes: The speck before 'vel' on the Mame page is not a letter (checked at 400 dpi).

latin: Quo finito, respondet Minister: Laus tibi, Christe, et Sacerdos osculatur Evangelium, dicens: Per evangélica dicta, ut supra.
Deinde facit signum Crucis cum Calice, et illum ponit super Corporale, et Palla cooperit: tum, junctis manibus super Altare, aliquantulum inclinatus, dicit:
Erectus expandit manus, easque in Altum porrectas jungens, elevatis ad cælum oculis, et statim demissis, dicit:
Postea, si solemniter celebrat, benedicit incensum, dicens:
Deinde incensat Altare, dicens:
Dum reddit thuribulum Diacono, dicit:
Postea incensatur Sacerdos a Diacono, deinde alii per ordinem. Interim Sacerdos lavat manus, dicens:
Deinde, aliquantulum inclinatus in medio Altaris, junctis manibus super eo, dicit:
Postea osculatur Altare, et versus ad populum, extendens et jungens manus, voce paululum elevata, dicit:
CANON MISSÆ
Commemoratio pro vivis
Jungit manus, orat aliquantulum pro quibus orare intendit: deinde manibus extensis prosequitur:
Tenens manus expansas super oblata, dicit:

Quibus verbis prolatis, statim Hostiam consecratam genuflexus adorat: surgit, ostendit populo, reponit super Corporale, et genuflexus iterum adorat: nec amplius pollices et indices disjungit, nisi quando Hostia tractanda est, usque ad ablutionem digitorum. Tunc, detecto Calice, dicit:
Genuflexus adorat: surgit, ostendit populo, deponit, cooperit, et genuflexus iterum adorat.
notes: Contiguous selection cut at the printed period: the 1962 book continues the sentence after Haec quotiescumque, and Mame begins it with a capital; the preceding 1962 clause 'deponit calicem super corporale, et dicens' is not carried (Mame adds 'secrete').

latin: Commemoratio pro defunctis
Jungit manus, orat aliquantulum pro iis defunctis, pro quibus orare intendit, deinde extensis manibus prosequitur:
Manu dextera percutit sibi pectus, elata aliquantulum voce dicens:
Particulam ipsam immittit in Calicem, dicens secrete:
notes: Rubric and formula both carried; the 1962 book prints a comma after Christi that Mame lacks (pointing only). The 1861 English joins the earlier fraction rubric to this immission and renders the formula itself.

latin: Hæc commíxtio, et consecrátio Córporis et Sánguinis Dómini nostri Jesu Christi fiat accipiéntibus nobis in vitam ætérnam. Amen.
notes: Rubric and formula both carried; the 1962 book prints a comma after Christi that Mame lacks (pointing only). The 1861 English joins the earlier fraction rubric to this immission and renders the formula itself.

latin: Cooperit Calicem, genuflectit, surgit, et inclinatus Sacramento, junctis manibus, et ter pectus percutiens, intelligibili voce dicit:
notes: Runs from printed p. 349 to p. 350. Mame 'intelligibili', 1962 'intellegibili': one word in two received spellings.

latin: In Missis Defunctorum non dicitur miserére nobis, sed ejus loco, dona eis réquiem, et in tertio additur sempitérnam.
Genuflectit, surgit, et dicit:

Deinde parum inclinatus, accipit ambas partes Hostiæ inter pollicem et indicem sinistræ manus, et Patenam inter eumdem indicem, et medium supponit, et dextera tribus vicibus percutiens pectus, elata aliquantulum voce, ter dicit devote et humiliter:
notes: Mame 'eumdem', 1962 'eundem': one word in two received spellings (precedent: the 2026-10-19 Canon projection).

latin: Postea dextera se signans cum Hostia super Patenam, dicit:
Deinde discooperit Calicem, genuflectit, colligit fragmenta, si quæ sint, extergit Patenam super Calicem, interim dicens:
notes: Contiguous selection beginning at the printed sentence 'Deinde discooperit'; in Mame it continues the paragraph that opens 'Et se inclinans', which this frame has no element for.

latin: Accipit Calicem manu dextera, et eo se signans, dicit:
Et sinistra supponens Patenam Calici, reverenter sumit totum Sanguinem cum particula. Quo sumpto, si qui sunt communicandi, eos communicet, antequam se purificet. Postea dicit:
Interim porrigit Calicem ministro, qui infundit in eo parum vini, quo se purificat: deinde prosequitur:
In Missis Defunctorum dicit:
notes: Selection cut at the printed colon before the versicle; Requiescant in pace is held on its own element.
